If you are a Singaporean or PR, you’re automatically covered by three national schemes:

MediSave
A national savings scheme which helps CPF members save for future medical expenses, especially during retirement.

MediShield Life
A health insurance for large hospital bills and selected outpatient treatment costs.

CareShield Life
Long-term care insurance scheme for financial support and monthly cash payouts in event of severe disability.
/-/media/project/prudential/lifestage/caring-for-elderly-parents-or-children/protection/what_they_may_consider.webp

Are you fully prepared for life's surprises with your current protection policies? It's crucial to ensure you have enough coverage to avoid a protection gap – when your savings, investments, and insurance fall short of covering unexpected expenses due to health issues.
Here's how to find out your protection gap3:
Calculate Needs: Multiply your annual income by nine (for death) or four (for critical illness)2. This is what your family will need to manage without your income.
Assess Resources: Add up your savings, assets, and current coverage. These are the funds available to your family.
Find The Gap: Subtract the needs from the resources.
If the result is negative, there's a protection gap. This means your family might struggle financially if something happens to you.
National schemes do not fully cover:

Hospitalisation
An Integrated Shield Plan (IP) provides additional coverage for private hospitals or higher ward classes in public hospitals.

Critical Illness
You’ll need coverage of 4x annual income. (Recommended)4

Death & Total and Permanent Disability
You’ll need coverage of 9 – 10x annual income. (Recommended)4
It’s recommended to spend at most 15% of take-home pay on insurance protection.

For Your Dependants
/-/media/project/prudential/lifestage/caring-for-elderly-parents-or-children/for-your-dependants/what_you_already_have.webp
If they are Singaporean or PR, they’re automatically covered by four national schemes:

MediSave  A national savings scheme which helps CPF members save for future medical expenses, especially during retirement. You can also use your MediSave to pay for medical bills incurred by your immediate family members.
MediShield Life  A health insurance for large hospital bills and selected outpatient treatment costs.
CareShield Life / ElderShield   Long-term care insurance scheme for financial support and monthly cash payouts in event of severe disability.
Dependants’ Protection Scheme7  Term life insurance scheme that provides basic financial protection for you and your family in the event of death, terminal illness or total permanent disability.
/-/media/project/prudential/lifestage/caring-for-elderly-parents-or-children/for-your-dependants/what_they_may_consider.webp
It’s important to plan ahead with proper and full coverage for your parents and/or children:
Critical Illness  Lump sum payout if they are diagnosed with a critical illness.
Life Insurance  Coverage for death, terminal illness and total permanent disability.
Personal Accident  Coverage for accidental death and injuries, including food poisoning, children-prone HFMD, and elderly-susceptible fractures.
Integrated Shield Plan  Additional coverage for private hospitals or higher ward classes in public hospitals.
Savings/Investment Plans  For milestones such as education and future home for your children and regular income during retirement for your parents.

Legacy Planning  A plan for a will, family trusts, life insurance, powers of attorney, and CPF nominations for your parents. If they are 55 years old or above, explore options to monetise their property (Silver Housing Bonus, Lease Buyback Scheme, renting out room / flat).

Premiums increase with entry age for selected policies, your child can reap the benefits of lower premiums in the long run.
